request.prompt: Fast, edgy jazz-funk chase music for an art heist gone loud at night. 80 BPM with a frantic double-time breakbeat feel, C minor, 4/4, steady tempo throughout. Opens with one huge brass and fuzz guitar hit on beat 1, then: tight breakbeat drums, a driving electric bass, a fuzz-toned funk guitar riff, a horn section with sharp stabs, a clavinet chopping chords, and the flute and trumpet together screaming a five-note minor blues motif. Sharp, stylish and dangerous. Structure: 1-bar hit, then 8-bar A, 8-bar B, 8-bar variation of A, 8-bar C, then back to A. No ending, no fade: it must loop seamlessly. Instrumental only, no vocals. No EDM, no synth bass, no four-on-the-floor kick, no risers.
